name: Nogg
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Nogg puts his craft to work for the Horde. The goblin engineer studies strange mechanical salvage from deep within Gnomeregan.

sections.title: Nogg's Workshop
sections.body: Nogg runs an independent engineering workshop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Adventurers and craftsmen come to him for the mechanical skill only a goblin can offer in a city known for orcish steel and strength. He is eager to examine unusual devices and trinkets brought back from Alliance lands or underground ruins.

sections.title: Gnomish Gadgets and Salvage
sections.body: Salvage from Gnomeregan draws Nogg's special attention. When Horde operatives recover intricate rings and other remnants from the fallen gnomish capital, few minds in Durotar can take apart, decipher, and adapt those strange clockwork devices for Horde use.

faq.answer: Nogg works from his engineering workshop in the Valley of Honor, inside Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is Nogg's connection to Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Horde adventurers salvage intricate devices from Gnomeregan's irradiated tunnels in Khaz Modan. Nogg, an expert in Orgrimmar, inspects and reconfigures the gnomish rings they bring back.

faq.q: Is Nogg part of the Horde?
faq.answer: Nogg is an independent goblin artisan in Orgrimmar who serves Horde adventurers with his technical skill.

faq.q: Can Nogg alter or reforge rings?
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Nogg a Sparklematic-extracted ring from Gnomeregan, and he can dismantle and rebuild it with different enchantments or mechanical properties.

angles.text: Engineers often visit Nogg's workshop in the Valley of Honor for parts and talk, and to watch him repurpose intricate gnomish devices with ease.
For Horde warriors returning from dangerous operations in the Eastern Kingdoms, Nogg can turn crude salvage into finely calibrated battle gear.
